title: step-n-fixed-point
description: The colimit of the ascending chain of step-n moduli substacks under the step-shift morphism - the corpus's candidate renormalization-group fixed point at infinite step depth, generated by passing to the limit over the step-n-moduli-substack family.

colimit.description: M^(infinity) := colim_{n->infinity} M^(n), the colimit of the ascending chain M^(2) -> M^(3) -> ... of step-n moduli substacks under the step-shift sigma-morphisms, a 2-stack whose objects are equivalence classes of step-infinity substitution rules with unbounded recurrence depth

stepShiftInvariant.description: fixed point of the step-shift flow: sigma(M^(infinity)) = M^(infinity); each finite-step iteration embeds into the colimit by its universal property and the colimit is invariant under further iteration

structuralContent.description: open question: whether the colimit is degenerate (trivial closure rule), a non-trivial classifier of all substitution-like closure rules at infinite depth, or naturally an infinity-stack; currently open
